Direct human amendment, 2026-10-07 15:54 UTC: “Native device testing should not block changes going out for review. Defer those checks”.

Native-device testing is deferred for review readiness, including the remaining native chooser checks for Calibrate PR439 and native unlock/focus, rotation, OS text scaling, screen-reader and reduced-motion checks for Little Say PR36. These checks remain unexecuted and their limitations must stay explicit; browser, component and bundle results must not be described as device execution.

All other gates remain: actionable human/code findings, CI and configured review, genuine captures and source/build/fixture provenance, independent pixel assessment, concise final descriptions, exact append-only QA receipts and coordinator verification. This does not authorize merge/release/deployment, resolve the separate partial-issue linkage choice, or revive cancelled actions. Existing owners must reconcile affected descriptions, then the same independent QA tasks reassess affected gates under the single-QA slot before any readiness transition. Runtime pins are unchanged.
